purpose: Teach: カーター/ジョブズ/ナイジェリア/アルメニア/プラトン/ユング/ラテンアメリカ/ローマ法王

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカーター元大統領の伝記を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father lent you that biography of President Carter, didn't he.
lines.style: Warm, slightly marveling tone. Soft opening. She's noticing something tender about the moment — the way her husband includes their son. Gentle pace, almost conversational.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとジョブズの伝記読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read the Steve Jobs biography with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager lean forward. Quick attack. He's offering this as his own small treasure, wanting to match what she's noticed. Genuine pleasure in sharing. Natural child pacing, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがナイジェリア出張のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father told you about his trip to Nigeria, didn't he.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant in a kind way. She's reflecting on how these moments accumulate — the father teaching the son. Steady pace. Quiet appreciation underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアルメニア料理屋さん行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to that Armenian restaurant with Dad.
lines.style: Quick, pleased. The brightness of a small boy reporting something he's proud of. Slight lift at the end like he's offering it to her. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがプラトンの本を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father lent you that Plato book, didn't he.
lines.style: Quieter now, more reflective. She's seeing a pattern — the depth of what her husband shares with their son. Slower pace. Slight wonder in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとユング心理学のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I listened to Dad talk about Jungian psychology.
lines.style: Earnest, proud of the grown-up word. He's reaching for something more sophisticated now. Still eager, but with a hint of concentration — he's learning to hold bigger ideas.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラテンアメリカ音楽の演奏会に行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's going to that Latin American music concert, isn't he.
lines.style: Warm with quiet marvel. She's almost marveling now at the breadth of it — music, philosophy, biography, travel. Gentle pace. A small smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとローマ法王のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a documentary about the Pope with Dad.
lines.style: Satisfied, warm close. He's accumulated these moments like small treasures. His voice settles — not eager-bright anymore, but content. He's shown her his world with Dad.
